name: Combat
entries: Sword duel: two people facing each other with staggered feet, each holding a sword forward, their blades meeting between them while their bodies remain apart.
Slip: one person throwing a straight punch while the other person bends their knees and shifts their head outside its path, both keeping their feet grounded.
Archery draw: the person standing side-on with feet apart, bow arm extended toward the target and the other hand drawing the string to the cheek, arrow aligned with the bow.
Shield block: one person advancing with a raised practice weapon while the other person braces behind a shield, front knee bent and rear foot planted.
Parry: two people facing each other at arm's length, one extending a practice blade while the other redirects it to the side with their own blade.
Boxing guard: the person standing with one foot forward, knees slightly bent, fists near the cheeks and elbows close to the ribs.
Front kick: the person balancing on one slightly bent leg, extending the other foot forward with their torso upright and hands raised for balance.
Side kick: the person balancing on one leg with their torso leaning away, the other leg extended sideways and the heel directed toward the target.
Kneeling guard: the person resting one knee on the ground with the other foot planted ahead, holding a shield in front without resting it on the raised knee.
Back-to-back defense: two people standing back-to-back with feet apart, facing opposite directions and each guarding the space in front of them.
Wrist release: two people facing each other, one gripping the other's wrist while the held person turns their wrist toward the opening between the gripping thumb and fingers.
The person crouching behind low cover with both feet planted, keeping their head below its upper edge while looking around one side.
